entities.name: Polonnaruwa Decline and Drift Southward

entities.summary: Magha of Kalinga's devastating invasion, the abandonment of Polonnaruwa, the shift of Sinhalese power southwestward through Dambadeniya and Yapahuwa, and the beginning of the Jaffna Kingdom.
